poem.content:
In secret caves, where shadows play,
Amidst the whispering darkness of the day,
A ghost of loneliness resides, a spectral heart,
Eroding the borders of the human part.

In shattered worlds, I feel a hesitant chime,
A gentle whisper asks, "Please, open in kind time,"
A dove's soft mutter echoing through the night,
A call to ancient loves, in love's profound light.

In orient seas of gold, a distant mirage,
A shimmering promise glows, an inner exigence,
To cast a reflection of what we dare discover,
When petals fall, and dawn impels that new hour.

Over layers of isolation we weave a jacket,
with patchwork threads, shadows frosting time into fragments.
A fractured line develops in our melancholy inside,
Ephemeral beacons wander – letting never fade.

Please make way for paths obscured from mindful thought,
Reflective diagram templates for ubi cream coasting below,
a branch lurking or shouldn’t occur, to name what dims 
Disconnect splitting mutual clash collections od perspective.
